task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First, it would be fantastic if you could try to travel south. And then, venture west. Then, make an attempt to venture south. Following that, go west. After that, make an effort to travel north. With that accomplished, make an effort to move north. Once you succeed at that, go to the west. And then, try to go to the west. If you can do that, head north. That done, take a trip west. Once you get through with that, travel west. And then, make an effort to travel south. And then, attempt to travel east. That done, attempt to move east. Okay, and then, attempt to venture east. Then, attempt to venture east. Then, go to the north. Then, travel north. If you can succeed at that, pick-up the coin from the floor of the cookery. And once you've done that, you win!
